description: DOE Building Technologies Office is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by DOE Office of Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy. This site displays research, development, and demonstration activities to accelerate the adoption of technologies and techniques that enable high-performing, affordable buildings that meet Americans’ need for resiliency and health while also supporting a reliable energy system. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Extreme Heat. Assets: Energy and Utilities, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
